# Delete each yesterday's request and create new ones with corrected amount (original - 5)
for req in yesterday_requests:
    old_id = req['payment_request_id']
    new_amount = req['amount'] - 5
    # Delete old request
    del_resp = apis.venmo.delete_payment_request(payment_request_id=old_id, access_token=access_token)
    print(f"Deleted {old_id}: {del_resp}")
    # Create new request with same receiver, description, private, corrected amount
    create_resp = apis.venmo.create_payment_request(
        user_email=req['receiver']['email'],
        amount=new_amount,
        access_token=access_token,
        description=req['description'],
        private=req['private']
    )
    print(f"Created for {req['receiver']['email']} amount {new_amount}: {create_resp}")
